dependencies.required_evidence: activated executable revision with source-bound arm semantics

contract.execution_rule: compile one source revision once and execute arms sequentially, never as simultaneous parent state copies
contract.trace_policy: rolling hashes at every 64-byte boundary; full details only at preregistered checkpoints and around first divergence

conditional_schedule.1000000: P/K/D; add O/R/S and deterministic D repeat only if D is positive and stable
conditional_schedule.10000000: P then D; stop on economic miss; add O/R/S and D repeat only on pass
conditional_schedule.distant_10000000: P/D; add S only after D passes

contract.abort_rule: P/K abort at first state or probability mismatch and retain a bounded divergence trace

activation_requirements: The executable candidate contract binds all command flags and artifacts
Debug-shadow and archive-proof outputs use distinct receipt classes
A shadow result can authorize only an archive-proof run
claim_boundary: Ideal-bit and probability diagnostics never earn compression credit
Only archive-proof mode can support promotion
